DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Assign or revoke access already included in this workspace's plan. This does not change the member's responsibilities.
VIEW_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: See which member-assigned features are available in this workspace.
NOT_ASSIGNED_TITLE: You don't have access to this feature yet
NOT_ASSIGNED_DESCRIPTION: Ask a workspace manager to assign access to you.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: This workspace plan does not currently include member-assigned feature access.
LOAD_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: We couldn't load the workspace's current access assignments. Try again before making changes.

PAYMENT_RECOVERY_ASSIGN_UNAVAILABLE: New access cannot be assigned until payment is recovered.
NO_CAPACITY: No access is currently available to assign.
CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: You can view this access, but you cannot change it.
CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE: This access cannot be changed right now.
CHANGE_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The workspace's access information may have changed. Review the current assignments before trying again.
CONFLICT_TITLE: Access changed before your request completed
CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: The latest assignments have been loaded. Review them before trying again.
AGENT_ACCESS_DESCRIPTION: Use AI assistants to help with workspace tasks.
